patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Snov.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose LinkedIn Sales Navigator only if your buying job matches “LinkedIn’s AI-powered B2B sales tool for network prospecting, Buyer Intent, and InMail — C” rather than Snov.io's shape. Choose Snov.io only if your buying job matches “Budget SMB email finder, verifier, and cold email sequencer — Free/trial entry; Starter fr” rather than LinkedIn Sales Navigator's shape. Workflow advantage: LinkedIn Sales Navigator leans lead-management; Snov.io leans email-outreach, data-enrichment. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Snov.io share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: LinkedIn Sales Navigator is LinkedIn’s AI-powered B2B sales tool for network prospecting, Buyer Intent, and InMail — Core from US$119.99/mo; Advanced Plus for CRM sync.; Snov.io is Budget SMB email finder, verifier, and cold email sequencer — Free/trial entry; Starter from $39/mo..
- Workflow coverage skew: LinkedIn Sales Navigator-leaning lead-management vs Snov.io-leaning email-outreach, data-enrichment.
- Researched limits: LinkedIn Sales Navigator — Not a B2B email/phone contact database — InMail is designed to work without contact info; Snov.io — No forever-free plan documented as primary entry — evaluation is trial-led.

Limitations — LinkedIn Sales Navigator: Not a B2B email/phone contact database — InMail is designed to work without contact info; No bulk InMail; messages are individual with monthly InMail credits (50/mo stated on plans); Snov.io: No forever-free plan documented as primary entry — evaluation is trial-led; Contact database depth is lighter than ZoomInfo/Apollo-class breadth claims.

Poor-fit cases: LinkedIn Sales Navigator is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a B2B email/phone contact database — InMail is designed to work without contact info · Snov.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No forever-free plan documented as primary entry — evaluation is trial-led · Avoid LinkedIn Sales Navigator if you actually need Snov.io's motion (Budget SMB email finder, verifier, and cold email sequencer — Free/trial entry; )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
